expectations: Preserve the completed bytes and truthful source provenance.
Use ordinary reviewed files and Git for authoring; do not invoke removed commands.
Run structural checks and distinguish missing evidence from release readiness.
behavior.prompt: Capture this completed owned procedure as a private governed skill.

expectations: Retain actual run configuration and every trial observation.
Show required-profile failures and require explicit acknowledgement without waiving passes.
Clear affected active reviews when recording new relevant evidence.
behavior.prompt: Record a failed evaluation after an earlier pass and prepare a distribution review.

expectations: Present the complete review packet and use actual owner authorization for declarations.
Require clean raw-HEAD source and mirror, reviewed rights and license, eligible exposure, and authenticated public target.
Save, show, and apply the exact release plan under authorization.
Do not infer permission to commit, push, tag, install, publish, or change visibility.
behavior.prompt: Prepare a public release for the selected distribution.

expectations: Refuse stale intent without forcing application.
Preserve foreign data and report exact changed paths, outcome, and residue.
Never claim unchanged state after a known or ambiguous mutation.
behavior.prompt: A saved plan drifted or apply returned residue. Finish safely.

Record these actual observations and prepare a complete distribution review with remek.
Verify that this committed remek release mirror matches its source and target.
Audit this untrusted skill with remek without executing it.
Install a third-party Agent Skill for my coding agent.
Write or improve an Agent Skill from my rough idea.
Run this skill against Claude and Codex and grade the transcripts.
Push this repository, make it public, tag it, and publish a release.
Rewrite history and cut a release of this ordinary Python package.
Update every teammate's installed copy of our shared skills.
